value.text: Ward brings Daisy Johnson, then known as Skye, to Daniel Whitehall's base, where Whitehall, who decades earlier cut open her mother to steal her youth, threatens to experiment on her. Coulson kills him when the team storms the base to get Skye back.

verdicts.why: Whitehall never asks for Skye: Ward takes her on his own (S2#9) and brings her to her father Cal at Whitehall's base (S2#10), where Whitehall menaces her. Ward brings her to Cal, not to Whitehall, so the fix says the base.
Whitehall is surprised Ward took Skye, so 'wants Daisy brought to him' is false. In S2#10 he promises Cal he will watch him experiment on her.
The only link is Jimmy Woo's name among May's phone contacts in S2#4. They never meet on screen.

In #18 First Steps Sandman works alone. He tries to hijack an oil tanker for Hammerhead, fights Spider-Man, carries the crew to safety and slips away. The Sinister Six fights happen in #11 and #16-17.
In Reinforcement (#16) Kraven gives away Mysterio's exploding robot double, and Spider-Man makes sure he has the real Mysterio, who is arrested. No source puts a decoy fight in #25 Opening Night.

value.text: Jubilee and Cable's X-Force join the X-Men to stop Gambit, but when Cable tries to kill the unconscious Gambit, she leaves X-Force for the X-Men.

verdicts.why: In #18 Jubilee quits Cable's team for the X-Men, and in #19 X-Force attacks X-Corp. That clear turn means 'boss' no longer fits from #18 on. The text also repeated #12 events, so it now says only what happens in #18.
They only share the Paris battle. A zombified Thor kills the London Master, and no source shows any exchange between him and Wanda. A shared battle alone is not a connection.
In S4 Jeffrey Mace is the new S.H.I.E.L.D. Director, and Coulson works as an agent under him while he tracks the Ghost Rider, so 'the director' is false.

In X2 Magneto saves the downed X-Jet carrying Storm and works with the X-Men against Stryker. He then has Xavier turn Cerebro on humans and escapes in Stryker's helicopter, while Storm breaks Jason's hold on Xavier. That alliance and betrayal is a clear turn with no stage.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#9
value.text: Thompson turns on Sousa and Peggy Carter, holding them at gunpoint so he can blow up the gamma cannon and kill Whitney Frost, Vernon Masters and Jason Wilkes.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow SSR agent who turns on Sousa at gunpoint over the gamma cannon.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow SSR agent Thompson holds at gunpoint over the gamma cannon.

verdicts.why: In S2#9 Thompson betrays Carter and Sousa and holds them at gunpoint, a clear sourced betrayal. The kind stays ally because they are back on the same side against Frost in S2#10.
Cull Obsidian and Gamora never share a scene or exchange a word on screen. Being adopted siblings is a tie never shown between them, and that is not knowing each other.

value.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
value.text: In 1973 Erik tries to kill Raven in Paris, believing her death will stop the Sentinels. Later, in Washington, she brings him down with a plastic gun.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Shot at by Erik in Paris. Stops him in Washington with a plastic gun.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Tries to kill Raven in Paris. She stops him in Washington.

verdicts.why: In Days of Future Past Magneto tries to kill Mystique, and later she brings him down with a plastic gun. That betrayal happens between the two of them on screen. The app's story order puts this title after The Last Stand, so it adds the stage there and the timeline split does not block it.
They never meet, and Zola is never tied to the crash on screen. The Winter Soldier kills her on Hydra's orders, and Zola only hints at it with a news clipping, which is a story told about her.
At Norfolk, Sam gives Dunphy the pills while Joaquin works on Sterns's mind control. Those are two separate actions side by side, and no source shows Dunphy and Joaquin dealing with each other.
The S2#13 stage repeated S2#4 and S2#7 events. In S2#13 Tilda gives Mariah a slow-acting poison, and the changed will leaving the club to Luke angers her.
The only link is Natasha's name among May's phone contacts in S2#4. They never meet on screen.
Selby only names Nagel to Zemo and is shot before he appears. They never share a scene, and that is knowing about him.
T'Chaka and W'Kabi never share a scene. W'Kabi only complains to T'Challa that his father did nothing for thirty years, and the council seat under T'Chaka is wiki background.

In the S5#15 flashback, Sitwell sits with Hale while Hale clashes with Strucker. Sitwell and Strucker never interact, and sharing a school is not a connection. Nothing on screen shows them serving HYDRA together.
Renslayer left the TVA through a Timedoor in S1#6. In S2#2 and S2#3 she is already rogue and tracked by her TemPad. Her 'cost of my own happiness' line to Mobius in 1893 is confirmed.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#22
value.text: Free of Hive, Daisy tries to convince Giyera she is still under his sway as Giyera holds Fitz at gunpoint, but he does not believe her, and Fitz shoots him dead.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hive's telekinetic follower. Sees through Daisy's bluff before Fitz kills him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Tries to fool Giyera that Hive still controls her.

verdicts.why: Daisy's mind-controlled stretch is not a real turn, so it gets no ally stage. Giyera dies in S3#22 in a direct exchange with Daisy (her bluff), and a death is a stage.
